# Weekend Bread Baking

Saturday is bake day. The dough is mixed on Friday night with a ladle of active starter, 75 percent hydration and a long cold proof in the fridge. The loaf goes into a preheated Dutch oven for twenty minutes with the lid on, then twenty more with it off. A crackling crust means the loaf is done; I let it cool for an hour before slicing.
The rise depends on a lively starter fed that morning; a sluggish jar gives a dense crumb however long the dough proofs.
